name: Base_Cup
notes: AZ pedestal. Step at the puck underside (r 84-96) is the greased thrust face; 192 mm bore is the journal. Stingray-4 on four pillars, 4x M4x40 from under the floor. 6x M6 in the foot flange for a mount plate.

name: Az_Retainer_Ring_A
notes: Retainer half A (+Y), goes in first: slides in from +Y under the drum, 4 open slots pass the pre-set hook screws (M4x20 into the pedestal nuts); lower tongue of both lap notches with 4 hex pockets underneath for the notch nuts.

name: Az_Retainer_Ring_B
notes: Retainer half B (-Y), goes in second: slides in from -Y over A's tongues, 4 open slots pass the hook screws; notch bolts 4x M4x20 down through both tongues. Print with support under the two tongues.

name: Az_Stingray4
notes: goBILDA Stingray-4 (4:1, 450 deg, 100 kg.cm), SKU 3215-0001-0004: direct AZ drive under the deck (block + servo + pinion).

name: Az_Stingray4_Output
notes: Stingray-4 output gear, hub and standoffs: turns with the head, bolted to the puck (4x M4x25 from the deck).

name: Arm_R_1
notes: Lower arm column (R), hollow (3 mm wall), cables inside. Feet 4x M4x25 from under the yoke plate into side-loaded nuts; socket for the upper spigot, 2x M4x50 across.

name: Arm_R_2
notes: Upper arm column + lower half of the shoulder drum (R), 4 mm shell open toward the hub: Stingray-9 channel with a 12 mm back plate (3x M4x20 along the axis into the block's back-face threads, driven through the window; 15 mm pocket for the shaft end), floor and cable opening into the column.

name: El_Bearing_Cap_R
notes: Upper half of the shoulder drum, 4 mm shell with a split-plane plate, 2x M4x50 into nuts trapped in the lower half; closes the top of the Stingray-9 channel, carries the upper back-plate screw and the upper half of the two split-plane screw holes.

name: Arm_L_1
notes: Lower arm column (L), hollow (3 mm wall), cables inside. Feet 4x M4x25 from under the yoke plate into side-loaded nuts; socket for the upper spigot, 2x M4x50 across.

name: Arm_L_2
notes: Upper arm column + lower half of the shoulder drum (L), 4 mm shell open toward the hub: pillow block for the left stub bushing, closed by the left axis cover.

name: El_Bearing_Cap_L
notes: Upper half of the shoulder drum, 4 mm shell with a split-plane plate, 2x M4x50 into nuts trapped in the lower half; holds the upper bushing half.

name: El_Bushing_L_Lower
notes: Half of the split plain bushing (36/30.5 x 40). Grease.

name: El_Bushing_L_Upper
notes: Half of the split plain bushing (36/30.5 x 40). Grease.

name: El_Axis_Cap_L
notes: Left axis cover: plain disc closing the stub bushing bore, translucent window; 4x M3x12 into bore-loaded nuts.

name: Status_Window
notes: Translucent disc in the left cap.

name: El_Servo_Cover
notes: Translucent 88 mm lens on the right shoulder drum showing the Stingray-9 and its screws; 4x M3x12 into window-loaded nuts.

name: El_Stingray9
notes: goBILDA Stingray-9 (9:1, 200 deg, 227 kg.cm), SKU 3215-0001-0009: direct EL drive in the right shoulder drum (block + servo + pinion).

name: El_Stingray9_Output
notes: Stingray-9 output gear, hub and standoffs: turns with the cradle, bolted to the hub's right wall (4x M4x12 from inside).

name: Head_Puck
notes: Rotating deck: 15 mm journal lip + thrust face (grease); bolted to the Stingray-4 standoffs (4x M4x25). Cable loop hole at the back.

name: Az_Drum
notes: Rotating azimuth housing (same diameter as the pedestal) = electronics bay. 4 pillars + ribs carry the yoke; M4x30 from below, M4x16 from above, nuts trapped in the pillars.

name: Logo_Light_Pipe
notes: Curved translucent plate behind the drum stencil (glue), LED behind.

name: Yoke_Plate
notes: Oval yoke plate / drum lid (244 x 220 mm): pillars 4x M4x16 from above (nuts in the pillars), arm feet 4x M4x25 each from below (nuts in the arm feet), translucent access cover 6x M3x25 (nuts under the plate).

name: Yoke_Access_Cover
notes: Translucent round access cover on the yoke plate (electronics visible); 6x M3x25 + nuts under the plate.

name: Cradle_Hub
notes: Hollow rounded hub, open top with a flush bolted lid: every flange bolt (left stub, boom, counterweight arm) ends in a nut inside the cavity; the right wall bolts straight onto the Stingray-9 standoffs.

name: Cradle_Lid
notes: Flush hub lid, 4x M3x12 into nuts trapped in the rim. Fit after all flange nuts and the standoff screws are in.

name: El_Stub_L
notes: Left EL stub axle, flange 4x M4x20 through the hub wall into nuts inside; turns in the split bushings.

name: Dish_Boom
notes: Round boom tube to the dish offset; round root flange 4x M4x20 into nuts inside the hub; round end flange takes either adapter (4x M5 + nuts).

name: Counterweight_Arm
notes: Round tube with a row of M4 holes for the canister collar; round root flange 4x M4x20 into nuts inside the hub.

name: Dish_Adapter_Plate
notes: Adapter A: slotted plate; 4x M5x12 into nuts pocketed in the boom flange.

name: Dish_Adapter_PipeStub
notes: Adapter B: 48.3 mm pipe stub.

name: Counterweight_Canister
notes: Opaque canister (~1.3 L); collar 2x M4x55 + nuts; cap 2x M3x10 with nuts inside the rim.

name: Counterweight_Cap
notes: Press cap, engraved PERIGEE; 2x M3x10 into nuts pocketed in the plug.

name: Dish_Reference_1m
notes: Reference paraboloid, not printed.

name: Feed_Reference
notes: LNB / feed placeholder.
